title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.13.66: Fixed the Book of Endings counter showing a stale study count after changing acts. The ring now reconciles to the true unspent bank on every map (re)generation - so a study spent revealing a boss no longer keeps showing as unspent in the next act, and existing saves self-heal on load. Mechanics were already correct; this was display-only.
